about: Rotating display copy for the Kerb Sense website. On each page load the site picks one entry per slot at random. The first entry in each slot is the default (used for tests, no-JavaScript and print). Pool written with Astra and checked against WEBSITE-STANDARDS.md (lengths, full stops, banned characters and words).
